subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 A poor girl, named Rina worked in a rich mans' home. The house master was kind to her but the mistress was very cruel. She used to scold her now and then. One day while serving tea, Rina broke a plate .............
